site.dial.axis.precision.def.text: Wie kohärent die Ausgabe ist – die Genauigkeit der Partikel des Glyphs, beeinträchtigt durch statisches Rauschen.

site.dial.axis.speed.def.text: Wie schnell der Sitz reagiert, wenn er aufgerufen wird – seine Antwortlatenz, skaliert auf 0–1.

review.issue: The term 'flow' in the source refers to the cognitive function, but the back-translation treats it as a general occurrence or a different concept.
review.back: Refilled in minutes – and in some cases during use (Flow).
The hangover plateau: ~30 min. during which the entire system runs weakly.
Incomplete — a part of the energy simply doesn't return today.
A slower supply; the stillness must be intentional.

Fe — extraverted feeling — is a judging function, therefore it provides judgments about the space instead of raw perceptions. Ti receives almost nothing to test and runs empty. Real stacks alternate between judging and perceiving precisely so that material is always being collected.
The emitter is glowing, but almost nothing reaches the grid.
Judgment evaluation feeds judgment evaluation

No — extraverted intuition, which is the auxiliary function here, provides many parallel possibilities instead of established facts. Ti builds broadly and provisionally: frameworks are designed, tested, and discarded cheaply, including frameworks for situations that do not yet exist.
The lattice becomes wide and airy, entire wings are raised and destroyed in seconds.
The INTP coupling

Ni — introverted intuition — receives few inputs, each arriving already condensed into a single interpretation. Ti receives little to test and much to accommodate, while fundamentally reorganizing it upon every arrival. No standard stack places Ni directly above Ti; this coupling is the website's own thought experiment.
an unusual coupling
Long silence, then the entire grid rearranges itself all at once.

Se — extraverted sensing — delivers a fast, dense stream of what is physically present right now. The analysis narrows down to what the object in front of you can confirm, and it is confirmed immediately. Troubleshooting logic: short feedback loops, little theory.
The lattice becomes narrow and load-bearing and thickens where the input lands.
The ISTP coupling

Si — introverted sensing, the tertiary function of the INTP — provides stored records instead of new perception. Ti re-proves old conclusions based on old data: still rigorous, increasingly isolated, as nothing was collected under test today. This is the loop, seen from the inside.
The grid contracts without growing – the same joints re-welded, the same spaces traversed once more.
The Loop coupling (Ti–Si, INTP under stress)
The same element, opposing settings: one instrument directed toward the world, one toward its own processes.

Where **Te** asks *"does it work?"* and builds external structures, **Ti** asks *"is it true?"* and builds internal coherence. Te trades elegance for speed; Ti trades speed for truth — a difference in what each is willing to pay, not in what each is capable of achieving.

What the space sees: an agreement that is being dismantled for sport. What is happening: Ti loads a claim the way an engineer loads a bridge, because someone might have to stand on it. The characteristic is that the testing is symmetrical — offer a Ti user a better attack on their own position and they accept it with visible gratitude, something no one who argues from sporting ambition has ever done.
Stress testing is the grid's only way to forge a connection.
You are only arguing for the sake of arguing.
the accusation

A grieving friend does not have a flawed model of the situation—and improving the model is the only movement that this function masters natively. Dominant Ti at the bedside provides a flawless root cause analysis, correct in every detail and wrong in its manner: the moment demands witnessing, not diagnosis. Mature Ti users learn to bring a different function to this door.
The grate is waiting in the car.
The condolence visit
the wrong instrument

An ESFJ under sustained stress suddenly becomes rigidly logical and argues technical details with an intensity that frightens everyone—including themselves. This is the Grip: an exhausted dominant gives control to the inferior Ti, which, lacking the calibration of an experienced Ti, breaks out.
The small grid runs hot and loud, instead of being large and quiet.
The inferior breakout
the grip

Tertiary Ti in an INFJ or ISFJ is logic as a garden rather than a residence: the flawless table for the community house, the private taxonomy of teas, the airtight argument that is practiced but never presented. It is dropped in the middle of the proof as soon as someone in the room needs something—in this stack, coherence is a pleasure and harmony is a duty.
A small grid that is brilliantly polished in places.
The Hobby Taxonomy
as tertiary

Under stress, the dominant Ti of an INTP pairs with the tertiary Si and re-proves old conclusions based on old data. The reasoning remains rigorous; the inputs are no longer new. Since both functions are inward-facing, nothing in the pair can contradict them—the pattern that typology forums refer to as a loop.
The lattice contracts without growing: flawless, airless, sealed.
The Loop
the loop

Both run cool and say 'that is wrong,' so both are constantly mixed up. Pay attention to what concludes a case. Te concludes on results—decided, sent, onward—and finds continued analysis self-indulgent. Ti reopens a settled matter at midnight because a definition is still shaky, and finds sending a shaky definition slightly scandalous. One optimizes the judgment; the other checks the logic that produced it.
The same cool surface, different mechanics underneath.

An observation just contradicts a rule upon which the model is based. The first reaction is not an alarm, but a remeasurement: Was the observation itself correct?
Stress floods the stage while the grid checks the measurement —

review.issue: The back-translation changes 'its conclusions' (singular) to 'their conclusions' (plural).
review.back: The newly constructed model now covers the exception. The reduction was not a malfunction — it is the maintenance that is responsible for performing this function, and the reason why their conclusions are trustworthy later.
...the color returns and the grid settles, visibly no longer the one it was a minute ago.
The re-observation confirms the exception, so any conclusion based on the broken rule is suspect and must therefore be reconstructed from scratch.

review.issue: The specific concept of 'red-shift' (a physical/astronomical phenomenon) was changed to a movement into a color.
review.back: The grid shifts into the red and tears itself apart.
Click a button to send an input to Ti and watch how it tests, integrates, or rebuilds around the incoming input.
A new fact arrives – true, but connected to nothing that holds Ti currently. It is laid down, without being forced to fit; not every observation has to find its place today.
The fact sits next to the grid like an island, in its own color.
Two islands are already waiting. Ti tolerates loose facts, but it itches for a bridge – try to discover a causal connection.
A potential connection arrives: a small causal claim that the parked fact follows from things the model already holds. It is tested before anything merges.

review.issue: The specific term 'lattice' was replaced with 'grate', which changes the visual image.
review.back: Watch how the bridge reaches from the grate to the island...

The connection holds, so the fact of being separate ceases: from now on, it is simply part of how the model describes the world. A successful verification is one of the few events that Ti registers as a pleasure.
Pleasure rises, stress subsides, and the entire construction folds into the grid and disappears.
No islands connected yet — Se first observes a fact...
Ti — Introverted Thinking · CURRENTS

review.issue: The meaning of 'trusted' was changed to 'becomes familiar'.
review.back: On the second seat, Ti is consciously engaged instead of running by default. It edits rather than composes: what the dominant perception function—Ne's possibilities or Se's live readings—contributes is stressed for consistency before it becomes familiar. Precision on demand, at moderate cost.
The grid is displayed in a size of four-fifths and grows in sessions instead of continuously.
An ENTP presents six ideas and then silently dismantles four of them before anyone else can.

On the sixth seat, Ti turns inward as a fault-finder: sporadic, harsh examinations of its own logic – "your definitions don't hold" – which are proclaimed as judgments rather than as help. It tests more reliably than it constructs.
Short red flashes traverse an otherwise dull grid — inspection without construction.
An ISTJ reads through their own report once more at midnight and finds only negligence, nothing of it specific enough to correct it.

The eighth seat occurs least often and is the most costly to manage. When it shows an outburst — usually at the end of a bad phase — it produces cold pseudologic directed at the self: an argument for one's own worthlessness, disguised as objectivity. It is the least practiced seat in the stack, no hidden truth.
An inverted lattice that builds downward — a structure recruited for demolition.
At 3 a.m., an INFP compiles an absolutely airtight piece of evidence that every opportunity has been wasted, including supporting evidence.

On the first seat, Ti runs without being switched on: every claim that occurs is tested against a private model of how things fit together, all day long, at low cost. Contradictions appear early and cheaply. The price is the speed — a claim is not usable until it is consistent, and consistency takes as long as it takes.
CURRENTS depicts this as a grid in full size – large, fast and quiet, growing without visible effort.
A new paper will be read on Monday; nothing will be said until a conclusion arrives on Thursday that reorders the rest.

review.issue: The back-translation adds 'Quenk Grip' instead of 'Quenk calls the grip', distorting the original phrasing.
review.back: On the fourth seat, Ti costs the most per use and is used the least. In daily life, the person borrows others' frameworks instead of building their own; under sustained stress, the seat can take over and produce a rigid, all-or-nothing logic that doesn't sound like them — the outburst that Quenk Grip calls the 'grip'.
The grid draws small and slowly, with visible noise – connections fail and land hard, if they land.
An ESFJ who has been hosting all week suddenly argues over a technical nuance down to the letter, in a tone that surprises both.

The fifth seat opens the shadow — the four positions that a person rarely and mostly unnoticed occupies. Here, Ti awakens fightingly: when the person's usual Te-logic is challenged, definitions are contested and the critic's logic is dismantled in order to protect the plan rather than to find something out.
Below the waterline of the rail, the grate fades and trembles, only coming together when it is nudged.
An ENTJ whose rollout is being questioned spends ten minutes attacking the grammar of the question.

In the tertiary position, Ti is authentic but narrow: reliable in a few practiced areas, unreliable outside of them, and noticeably stronger with age. Under stress, it can pair with the dominant function to defend conclusions that no outsider is allowed to scrutinize — the pattern known as a Loop.
A half-grid, bright where it is used, and sparse everywhere else.
An ISFJ's home table is flawless; that same precision is never risked in a meeting.

On the seventh seat, requirements for formal consistency are perceived more as traps than as tools. The person escapes them—through charm, absurdity, or a change of subject—and truly does not see the rule they are supposedly breaking. The blindness is real, not tactical, and there is no clumsiness in it.
The grid is marred by missing parts and does not close — edges that should meet do not.
If an ESFP is asked to admit that two of their statements are contradictory, they laugh, agree with both, and move on.
Interactive visual representation of Introverted Thinking as a crystalline lattice
The eight faces of Ti

The canvas represents Ti as a grid: a network of claims, each cross-referenced against the others. Where Ti sits in a person's stack—the fixed order in which their eight functions appear—changes how this network functions. Click on a position to see the change, from the effortless precision of the first seat to the corrosive noise of the eighth, and slide the maturation slider to see how the lower seats gain precision with age.
Stack positions for Ti
What does Ti eat?

Ti evaluates; it does not collect. A perceiving function – its supplier – must provide the raw material that Ti checks, and which function supplies, changes what is being constructed. Click on a supplier to see how the grid changes.
Simulation stage of the verification laboratory
Zone D · Verification Laboratory

Observe how Ti processes inputs in real-time. Each button sends a different type of event to the lab – a disconnected fact, a connection, a contradiction – and the measuring devices track what each of them costs.
Patterns from the wilderness – how Ti appears in daily life.
